action_items: MINOR / CODE-DRIFT (not a functional bug): The review_request summary claims AdminPage.jsx HistoryTab detail rows now use `key={row.page_id}` and serial list uses `${rowKey}-sn-${s||k}`, but the on-disk file at lines 672 and 689 still shows `key={j}` and `key={k}` (array indices). Functionality is unaffected (no React key warnings observed since indices are unique within their arrays), but the described fix appears to NOT be applied to AdminPage. ChecklistPage sn key `${it.id}-sn-${idx}` is also still index-based on-disk (line 485 uses `${testKey}-sn-${idx}` with testKey = `item-${it.id}`), which matches the description functionally. Main agent may want to reconcile the description with the actual code if the intent was to move away from index keys.
critical_code_review_comments: BarcodeScanner catch blocks at lines 43-45 and 47-49 still use silent `/* ignore */` comments (no console.debug call). The problem statement said they now log via console.debug — this change appears NOT applied on disk. No functional regression, but worth reconciling.
AdminPage.jsx HistoryTab row/serial keys remain index-based on disk despite the review_request stating they were converted to stable keys. See action_items.
